title: hieracium tommasinianum subsp. castelli-novi
intro: Hieracium tommasinianum subsp. castelli-novi, commonly known as Mountain Hawkweed, is a plant species native to the mountainous regions of the Italian peninsula. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Hawkweed are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant and hepatoprotective effects. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
